evals.prompt: Write chapter 4 (Binary Search) of the DSA course in ./courses. Keep it to one signature figure.
evals.expected_output: courses/dsa/chapters/04-binary-search/chapter.md following the chapter arc (hook, figure, invariant, code, variants, complexity table, pitfalls, 3-4 transfer checks, recap); figures/fig-01-*/ with brief.md, model.mjs and an Anatomy build.mjs producing dark and light HTML; dist/04-binary-search.html built; check_pages.py passes on desktop and mobile+dark; numbers in text, readout and caption agree.
expectations: chapter.md has front matter with title, dek, chapter: 4, minutes, outcomes
Exactly one ::figure directive, placed in the 'watch it work' part of the arc
brief.md fills every section (idea, truth, object, interaction, card text)
Every code block in the chapter was executed during the session
A complexity table and an [!INTERVIEW] callout with 3-5 named problems are present
check_pages.py was run and its only PROBLEM lines, if any, are deliberately pending figures
No em dashes in chapter.md, brief.md or the figure card text

evals.prompt: Plan a 'Computer Networks for Developers' course: about 20 hours, intermediate, for web developers.
evals.expected_output: courses/computer-networks/course.json (or similar slug) with 5-8 outcomes, prerequisites, chapters in dependency order sized to ~20 hours, each with summary, outcomes, topics and one planned figure (concept + object); price null; course page and catalog built; the syllabus is shown and chapter 1 is offered, not written.
expectations: every chapter has exactly one planned figure with a concept and a physical object
chapter minutes sum to roughly the stated hours
build_course.py was run and the syllabus page exists
no chapter.md was written without being asked
no em dashes in course.json text (tagline, summaries, outcomes)

evals.prompt: Make a one-page cheat sheet on hashing for revision, using the existing DSA course.
evals.expected_output: A cheatsheet.md (kind: cheatsheet) under the hashing chapter or notes/, made of tables, patterns and one-liners, no new figures, linking the chapter page; built with build_chapter.py and passing check_pages.py.
expectations: no new figure folders were created
no prose paragraph longer than two sentences
complexity numbers match the hashing chapter
no em dashes anywhere in the cheat sheet
